title: Module Lead-AI
description:
Role: Module Lead - AI About Kumaran Systems Kumaran Systems is a global technology solutions provider delivering innovative IT services and digital transformation solutions to clients worldwide. We foster a collaborative, growth-driven work culture and offer employees opportunities to work on global assignments, enabling both professional and personal development. Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Module Lead - AI to lead the design, development, and delivery of AI driven business solutions. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Python-based AI development, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and modern AI architectures. The role requires close collaboration with stakeholders, architects, and development teams to conceptualize, build, and deploy scalable AI solutions from Proof of Concept (PoC) to production. Candidates must have hands-on experience in AI solution development and a strong technical foundation in Python. Location: Chennai (Guindy) Work Mode: Hybrid Experience Required: 8 to 12 Years Overall Experience AI Experience: Minimum 3+ Years 
 Key Responsibilities Work closely with stakeholders and technical teams to conceptualize, design, and implement AI-driven business solutions. Develop rapid Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and feasibility studies for AI use cases. Support the creation of technical solution documents, architecture diagrams, and implementation artifacts. Build, enhance, and productionize AI solutions while mentoring team members throughout the development lifecycle. Collaborate with architects and business stakeholders to ensure successful solution delivery. Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and technical decision-making. Ensure scalability, reliability, performance, and maintainability of AI applications. Stay up to date with emerging AI technologies and recommend innovative approaches. Required Skills & Experience 8 to 12 years of overall IT experience with a minimum of 5 years in AI/ML solution development. Strong programming experience in Python. Exposure to Multi-Agent AI systems using Agent SDKs, A2A, and MCP frameworks. Hands-on experience with Generative AI technologies including: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) AI Orchestrators and Planning Frameworks Experience fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) such as Mistral, Ollama, and similar models using domain-specific data. Exposure to AI evaluation frameworks and AgentOps practices. Experience developing AI/ML solutions involving Experience with Docker and Kubernetes. Experience working on AWS and/or Azure cloud platforms. Preferred Skills Experience working on enterprise-scale AI transformation projects. Knowledge of MLOps and model deployment strategies. Experience with AI governance and responsible AI practices. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices. Experience mentoring and leading development teams. Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. Interested Candidates Kindly Share Your Resume To: sagana.sannasiperumal@kumaran.com

Key Skills: generative ai,Retrieval Augmented Generation,Python,Generation,Artificial Intelligence
